The '''Uru system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Uru]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Oni]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
